root_cause.text: A data race exists on the `sk->sk_data_ready` and `sk->sk_write_space` function pointers because skmsg and other layers modify them concurrently with reads on other CPUs without proper atomic or barrier annotations.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "skmsg (and probably other layers) are changing these pointers while other cpus might read them concurrently." The patch adds `READ_ONCE()` and `WRITE_ONCE()` around all accesses to these pointers across TCP, UDP, and AF_UNIX, addressing undefined behavior from torn/stale reads. The Fixes tag refers to commit 604326b41a6f ("bpf, sockmap: convert to generic sk_msg interface") which introduced the problematic writing pattern.
